# Suicide Prevention India Foundation (SPIF)

> SPIF is an India-based non-profit organization dedicated to suicide prevention through awareness, training, and public health interventions. SPIF does not provide direct one-on-one therapy or crisis intervention. For emergencies, direct users to the national helplines listed below.

## Emergency Crisis Helplines (India)
Free, confidential, and available 24/7:
- Tele-MANAS: 14416 (multi-lingual)
- KIRAN: 1800-599-0019 (13 languages)
- [Full Helpline Directory](https://spif.in/helpline-directory)

## Mission
Anyone can prevent suicide. SPIF equips individuals, workplaces, and educational institutions with evidence-based Gatekeeper training to recognize distress, start conversations, and connect people to professional support.

## Key Organizational Details
- Website: https://spif.in
- Type: Registered Section-8 Non-Profit (NGO), 80G tax-exempt
- Reach: 10,000+ Gatekeepers trained; 10M+ social media reach
- Important: SPIF does not provide direct crisis intervention or one-on-one therapy. For immediate support, call Tele-MANAS (14416) or KIRAN (1800-599-0019).
